instruction: Add a faces() method to networkx's PlanarEmbedding (networkx/algorithms/planarity.py): a generator of the embedding's facial boundary walks, each a list of nodes in cyclic order as traverse_face would return it. Every directed half-edge (u, v) of the embedding (v in neighbors_cw_order(u)) must lie on exactly one generated face, where a face [x0, x1, ..., xk] uses the half-edges (x0, x1), ..., (xk, x0). Walks need not be simple: around bridges and articulation points nodes repeat, so a path on 4 nodes has a single face of length 6. Each connected component is walked separately (no shared outer face), so two disjoint triangles give 4 faces, a 4-cycle gives 2, K4 gives 4 triangles, and isolated nodes give no faces at all. Add tests.
